Changes made for clearer vocabulary

  • Fork (U+1F374): separate knife removed; fork centered and enlarged.
  • Plate (U+1F37D): utensils removed; plate centered and enlarged; fill lightened.
  • Bowl (U+1F963): spoon removed; bowl centered.

The cup is an original simple vector illustration created for Little Objects, also distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Other OpenMoji object illustrations are unchanged. No endorsement by OpenMoji is implied.

The artwork license applies to the image assets and their adaptations; it is not a blanket license statement for unrelated application code.

Lesson picture cards

Lesson cards combine OpenMoji icons with original vector symbols, layouts and teaching captions. These adapted image cards are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Sources and changes are recorded in topics.json; the source icons are included under assets/lessons/icons. Original teaching texts were written for this project. Informal meme terms can have shifting meanings; the teen lesson treats six seven and skibidi as playful terms without a fixed meaning.

Meme references: Dictionary.com: 67 · Dictionary.com: skibidi.

Advanced meaning cards

Lessons 1–3 use original bilingual teaching text and original vector layouts, without third-party illustrations. The card images are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. C1/C2 labels describe teaching targets, not an official rating for every headword; technical terminology and topic nouns are practised in demanding contexts. Primary reference links are recorded in topics.json.
